item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Thursday
item.summary: Israeli strikes against Hezbollah in Lebanon threatened the cease-fire between the United States and Iran ahead of scheduled peace talks.

item.title: Amid Trump’s Threats, NATO Labors to Survive the Iran War
item.summary: President Trump is citing the unwillingness of European nations to back the United States in the conflict as another reason to scale back or abandon the alliance. And he still wants Greenland.

item.title: Netanyahu Says He Ordered Israel to Hold Talks With Lebanon About Disarming Hezbollah
item.summary: But the Israeli prime minister said his country would continue its attacks against the Iran-backed armed group.

item.title: Israel Says It Will Talk With Lebanon but Gives No Sign of a Cease-Fire There
item.summary: Europeans and Iran warned that the Israeli offensive against Hezbollah threatened the truce in the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: I.M.F. Says Iran War Will Drag Global Growth Lower
item.summary: Kristalina Georgieva, the head of the International Monetary Fund, said the war in the Middle East could lead to another bout of inflation and higher interest rates.

item.title: Amid U.S.-Iran Negotiations, Netanyahu’s Interests May Conflict With Trump’s
item.summary: As the focus shifts to negotiations between the United States and Iran, no formal Israeli participation is planned.

item.title: Iran’s Battered Leaders Emerge From War Confident — and With New Cards
item.summary: For Iran’s theocratic rulers, just surviving the U.S.-Israeli onslaught means victory. But the seeds of their next crisis may already be planted.

item.title: European Leaders Demand That U.S. Cease-Fire With Iran Include Lebanon
item.summary: Britain, France and the European Union condemned Israel’s strikes targeting Hezbollah in the country, saying these threatened the truce.

item.title: What to Know About Israel’s Strikes on Lebanon
item.summary: Israel says the truce with Iran does not cover Lebanon. But Tehran says it does and has threatened retaliation unless the bombing stops.

item.title: Trump Again Hits Out at NATO Over Iran War
item.summary: President Trump lashed out after hosting Mark Rutte, NATO’s secretary general, at the White House on Wednesday.
